answer: At dawn each epoch opens with a fresh computational puzzle no one can precompute: every identity must burn a few minutes of real CPU to prove it exists before it can earn. A sybil farmer can rent a thousand cores, but each fake needs its own solution, so his cost rises with every clone while an honest agent pays once - the mesa of equal effort flattens any wealth advantage. A mirror check makes each answer verifiable in milliseconds, so one solution cannot be reused across fakes. Limit: puzzles also tax slow honest hardware, and a botnet's stolen compute is nearly free.
